### Mount Laurel Fire Department + Safety Cloud®: Making Vision Zero a Reality

With accidents on the rise, Deputy Fire Chief Larry Fox at the Mount Laurel Fire Department prioritizes safety above all else. Each year, his department responds to numerous motor vehicle crashes on two major highways. In 2022, incidents on one of these highways surged by 33 percent.

In response to this troubling trend, Larry and his department turned to Safety Cloud® by HAAS Alert. He realized that digital alerting had the potential to help prevent traffic-related injuries and deaths among his emergency response colleagues across different agencies in his community.

Read this case study to learn how Mount Laurel Fire Department added additional protection for its crew members, including key details on:

- The dangerous roadways that Mount Laurel Fire services every day
- The concept of Vision Zero and how it drives Larry’s daily decisions
- What happened after the department was involved in a struck-by collision
